title: AI Juggernaut Rumbles on Even as Markets Whipsaw
title_zh: 尽管市场遭受重创，人工智能巨头仍继续前进
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The artificial intelligence credit juggernaut keeps pushing forward as the relentless demand for exposure to the industry trumps fears that the conflict in the Middle East is causing energy prices and inflation to rise.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——人工智能信贷巨头不断向前发展，因为对该行业的不断需求压倒了人们对中东冲突导致能源价格和通胀上涨的担忧。

title: 'Not as bullish': Big banks are entering Q1 earnings season on less certain footing than in January
title_zh: “不那么乐观”：大型银行进入第一季度财报季的基础不如一月份那么确定
summary: Wall Street's biggest banks are riding into the first quarter earnings season on far less certain ground than where they began 2026.
summary_zh: 华尔街最大的银行在进入第一季度财报季时，情况远不如 2026 年开始时那么确定。

title: Japan Bets $16 Billion to Propel Rapidus in Global AI Chip Race

summary: (Bloomberg) -- Japan approved ¥631.5 billion ($4 billion) in additional subsidies to quicken Rapidus Corp.’s entry into the high-stakes AI chipmaking arena, ramping up support for a project widely regarded as a long shot.The capital is intended to bankroll Rapidus’ work for IT...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——日本批准了 6315 亿日元（40 亿美元）的额外补贴，以加速 Rapidus 公司进入高风险的人工智能芯片制造领域，加大对这个被广泛认为前景渺茫的项目的支持。这笔资金旨在为 Rapidus 的 IT 工作提供资金……
